_what: Rules for tool:look-at-screen and tool:picture-an-app-window. long_edge: the longest edge of each returned picture in pixels (a request may ask for smaller, never larger). format: the picture format (jpg or png). max_answer_bytes: the most one answer may hold, kept under what a run may return (262144 bytes in product/tool-runs.json); when the pictures are larger, every picture is made smaller by shrink_by until they fit, down to least_long_edge. words: what it says.

words.done: This is what is on the screen now, the main display first; each picture gives its size in pixels.
words.needs_access: Turn on Screen Recording for the app that runs this tool in System Settings, Privacy & Security, so it can see your screen when you ask.
words.too_many_displays: The displays are too many for one answer even at the smallest picture size. Disconnect some displays or ask again.
words.window_done: This is the app's frontmost window as it is on the screen now; the picture gives its size in pixels.
words.no_window: That app has no window on the screen now. Open it, or bring one of its windows back from the Dock, and ask again.
words.too_large: The window is too large for one answer even at the smallest picture size. Ask again for a smaller long_edge.
